working_title: Beyond the Algarve: Why Comporta Should Be on Every UK Golfer's Radar
angle: While UK golfers default to the Algarve for a Portugal golf trip, the emerging cluster of courses at Terras da Comporta, just an hour south of Lisbon, now offers a genuinely compelling alternative. The post makes the practical case for why a Comporta trip, anchored by two distinct world-class layouts on the same stretch of Atlantic coastline, is worth serious consideration for 2026 or 2027.
research_notes:
- Terras da Comporta sits roughly one hour south of Lisbon, on the edge of the Sado Estuary Nature Reserve (source: Golfbreaks, portugalgolf.net). Some sources cite 1 hr 20 mins from Lisbon Airport.
- The resort is home to two championship courses: the Dunas Course and the newly opened Torre Course.
- Dunas Course: designed by David McLay-Kidd (Bandon Dunes, Machrihanish Dunes, Castle Course at St Andrews). Par-71, over 7,205 yards from the back tees, built across 84 hectares of natural sandy terrain. Opened 2023. Described as a true links layout, unique in Portugal. Festuca grass fairways. Quickly recognised as one of the best courses in continental Europe.
- Torre Course: designed by Sergio Garcia (his first full design project). Opened summer/second half of 2025. Named 2025 World's Best New Golf Course at the World Golf Awards. Stretches 6,900 yards from member tees, extendable beyond 7,300 yards. Inspired by Valderrama, notable for smaller, strategic greens and varied par threes. Spans 41.4 hectares of natural landscape.
- The Comporta region has been noted as an emerging destination by golf travel experts; Golfshake's travel editor specifically called out the 'Blue Coast' / Comporta cluster as the 2026 destination 'for those in the know,' distinct from the well-trodden Algarve and Silver Coast.
- The coastal region has been nicknamed 'the new Portuguese Riviera' in some travel coverage.
- Nearby stay option: Sublime Comporta, described as a 65-acre retreat with 23 rooms and suites (no prices available from research).
- Algarve context for comparison: top Algarve courses can cost upwards of €150 per round at peak season; green fees are lowest in December and summer months. No comparable green fee figures found for Comporta specifically (one reviewer on Albrecht Golf Guide referenced ~€200 per round as a data point but this is a single unverified user comment, not a confirmed published rate, so do not cite as fact).
- UK golfers fly into Lisbon, which has strong direct connections from UK airports. No need to travel all the way to Faro.
- Comporta area features umbrella pines, Atlantic dunes, and natural unspoiled coastline. The Dunas Course runs alongside Praia do Pego beach.
- Post should note the 'bolt-on Lisbon city break' angle as a differentiator from the Algarve.
